root_cause.text: The function `l2cap_ecred_data_rcv()` reads the SDU length field from the skb without first verifying that the skb contains at least L2CAP_SDULEN_SIZE (2) bytes, causing an out-of-bounds read when the received packet is too short.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states that `get_unaligned_le16(skb->data)` is called without checking `skb->len >= L2CAP_SDULEN_SIZE`, and the patch adds a `pskb_may_pull(skb, L2CAP_SDULEN_SIZE)` check before that read.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add length check before reading SDU length in l2cap_ecred_data_rcv to prevent out-of-bounds access.
intent_record.what: Added a call to pskb_may_pull to check that the skb contains at least L2CAP_SDULEN_SIZE bytes before reading the SDU length; if not, set err to -EINVAL and goto failed.
intent_record.how: This prevents the function from accessing data beyond the skb's length, avoiding potential memory corruption or crashes when processing malformed packets. Instead, it returns an error.
